name: Sarashina Mutsumi
source: One of the 3 warrior representatives of the Sarashina house and is currently the family head. Has an easygoing atmosphere while also being a remarkable swordswomen known by many veterans. However now having put down the sword, she is now the shopkeeper of a restaurant called "Miyoshi", now living a normal life
